title: Journey-ahead list wasn't resyncing with the Road Ahead bubble
changes: Fixed the "Your journey ahead" timeline sometimes not showing an upcoming event (e.g. Picture Matching) that the Road Ahead bubble already knew about. Root cause: the timeline list renders once when you open Journey, and that can happen before the roadmap engine has finished loading — nothing then re-triggered it once the data arrived. The Road Ahead bubble never had this problem because it's the last script in the load chain, so it always computes with fresh data by construction.
The roadmap engine now proactively refreshes the journey-ahead list the moment it finishes its first computation, so the two can no longer drift apart.
